title: Internet Assigned Numbers Authority (IANA) Procedures for the Management of the Service Name and Transport Protocol Port Number Registry
summary: Defines the procedures IANA uses when handling requests to the Service Name and Transport Protocol Port Number registry, and explains the rationale behind them. It updates IANA's procedures and replaces earlier UDP and TCP port assignment procedures. It is a best current practice.

eli5.summary: Port numbers are like apartment numbers for programs. This is the rulebook IANA follows when someone asks for a number or name, written so the limited supply lasts a long time.
